text_block_list.text:
New Year's Day is the time to set one's 
plans for the year. I went on a shrine 
visit together with Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, we're in the Senior Class 
starting this year♪ Come on, let's go make 
our New Year's visit~."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever is within my power, but 
please pray to God for anything beyond 
that, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My mind is already made up. This is the 
only way.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
May the two of us stay healthy all 
throughout this year.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this is plenty♪ As long as I have my 
health, I believe any dream can come true.

Having overcome last year's trials, Super 
Creek seemed full of confidence.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, what will you wish for? Come 
on, go ahead♪
What I wish for Super Creek is...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Holy Mother... You certainly asked for 
something incredible, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I do wish to be a kind person, but whether 
I can truly achieve that or not...
—And so, around lunchtime that day...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I made some ozoni. Usually I have 
two mochi, but~ today there are three.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything else you'd like to ask 
for? If so, don't hold back, just let me 
know♪

Bustling about with thirty percent extra 
tenderness. Taking on the housework seems 
to have built up her stamina as well.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Explosive fighting spirit...? Does that 
mean she's an older girl full of energy?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Got it~. I'll give it a try, then.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Bada-boom! Think a little workout like 
this is gonna wear me out~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Bring on the dumbbells next~. Bab-boom! 
Pure fighting spirit bursting out~.

"Are those occasional sound effects 
supposed to be explosions? I don't really 
understand, but overall it seems to have 
gotten a lot more intense."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, housework, is it? I can manage the 
basics passably well... but I certainly 
still have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll try pushing myself one step 
further this year. All right.
One hour later—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Phew... All done with my errands~! Let's 
head home, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, no reason~ ♪

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's with this shrine approach...! 
The stone pavement is sparkling clean?!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the work of God? The path 
appears to be shining...!

Super Creek briskly walks away. It seems 
I'll be able to learn many more techniques 
from her.
